news.title: Non Executive Chairman recently bought ₹62k worth of stock
news.body: On the 13th of March, Sudhir Sethi bought around 3k shares on-market at roughly ₹20.23 per share. This transaction amounted to less than 1% of their direct individual holding at the time of the trade. This was the largest purchase by an insider in the last 3 months. This was Sudhir's only on-market trade for the last 12 months.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.0% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Interest payments are not well covered by earnings (0.5x net interest cover). news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹0.33 loss per share (vs ₹0.10 profit in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹0.33 loss per share (down from ₹0.10 profit in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹38.5m (down 28% from 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹1.68m (down 421% from profit in 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 45% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 21% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.

news.body: Beryl Drugs Limited announced that they will report Q3, 2026 results on Feb 09, 2026

news.title: Beryl Drugs Limited Announces Resignation of Neha Sharma as Company Secretary and Key Managerial Personnel, Effective January 3, 2026
news.body: Beryl Drugs Limited announced that Ms. Neha Sharma has tendered her resignation from the position of Company Secretary and Key Managerial Personnel of the Company, effective January 3, 2026, due to personal and unavoidable circumstances. Ms. Neha Sharma submitted her resignation letter dated December 23, 2025, stating that she is resigning due to personal reasons and confirming that there are no other material reasons for her resignation other than those mentioned.

news.title: Beryl Drugs Limited Approves the Appointment of Kamlesh Gupta as the Company Secretary, Effective January 4, 2026
news.body: Beryl Drugs Limited at its board meeting held on January 3, 2026 approved the appointment of Mr. Kamlesh Gupta as the Company Secretary of the Company designated as the Key Managerial Personnel with effect from January 4, 2026. Brief profile: He is a member of Institute of Company secretaries of India.

news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.02 (vs ₹0.014 in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.02 (up from ₹0.014 in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹51.6m (down 8.2% from 2Q 2025). Net income: ₹89.0k (up 29% from 2Q 2025). Profit margin: 0.2% (up from 0.1% in 2Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by lower expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 17% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 38% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.
